description: Prevent Bolster, Lock On, and Activate from falling through to the generic mech-skill chooser while their dedicated workflows remain unimplemented.
planning_goal: Audit Frame Conn actions that do not traditionally require an action check or mech skill roll. Preserve already-correct Boot Up, Shut Down, Hide, Scan, Disengage, Stabilize, Prepare, Self-Destruct, Overcharge, Brace, and Protocol behavior. Fix Bolster, Lock On, and Activate so they cannot fall through to the generic HULL/AGI/SYS/ENG chooser; until dedicated target/system workflows are implemented they should be classified as no-roll/no-current-workflow rather than executable stat checks. Preserve all attack, contested-check, and ordinary skill-check routing.
